figures.finding: The minimum age for an adolescent's paid work in Cabo Verde is fifteen (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente, art. 61); the State may set higher ages for hazardous work, and below fifteen a child may only help with household or farm tasks in the family.

value.lightNote: no light-work age below fifteen; art. 65 allows only household or agro-pastoral tasks within the family
value.law: Lei n.º 50/VIII/2013 (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente), arts. 61 and 65

figures.applies: Every adolescent (twelve to eighteen) resident or present in Cabo Verde. The Código Laboral (Decreto-Legislativo 5/2007) was not read.
figures.webSearch: 2026-11-01: (1) 'Cabo Verde Código Civil "dezoito anos" maioridade artigo 122 menor; Código Laboral idade mínima admissão emprego menores 15 anos': returned FAOLEX's copy of the Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente (Lei 50/VIII/2013), read (art. 61). (2) '"Cabo Verde" "Código Civil" "É menor ..."': no labour-code text; the Código Laboral's own article was not reached.

sources.said: A idade mínima para trabalho remunerado do adolescente é fixado em quinze anos.

figures.finding: An adolescent worker in Cabo Verde may validly make the contracts tied to their own work; the contract must be in writing, the employer must have it endorsed by the central labour service, and the adolescent must register in the Register of Adolescent Workers; overtime is forbidden. No set-aside of earnings is required.

value.binding: the adolescent contracts for themself (art. 62.1); written contract (art. 64.1); endorsement ('visado') by the labour service (art. 63.2); registration (art. 63.1)
value.setAsideNote: no set-aside found in the ECA
value.reachesRoles: any paid work by an adolescent; no rule special to performing, writing or directing

figures.applies: Adolescents from fifteen (the work age) to eighteen.
figures.webSearch: 2026-11-01: (1) and (2) as for the work age: the ECA (Lei 50/VIII/2013) read, arts. 62 to 64; no rule on a performer's or author's contract and none on setting earnings aside was found.

sources.said: É reconhecido ao adolescente trabalhador o direito de celebrar validamente actos, contratos e convenções colectivas relacionadas com a sua actividade laboral e económica nos termos da lei.
As pessoas individuais ou colectivas que contratarem serviços de adolescente são obrigadas a assegurar de que o contrato é visado pelo serviço central competente responsável pela área do Trabalho.
O contrato de trabalho do adolescente deve ser reduzido a escrito

figures.finding: Cabo Verde's state support for film (NuNaC's calls under Lei 99/IX/2020) is open to natural or legal persons registered as a film or audiovisual company, with tax and social-security affairs in order and no default on earlier state support; the rules set no age, so an applicant must first be able to register such a business.

value.capacityRule: regularly constituted and registered as an empresa cinematográfica e/ou audiovisual; tax and social security regularised; no default on state support; no public-procurement impediment
value.law: Decreto-Regulamentar n.º 4/2021 (B.O. I Série n.º 40, 16 April 2021), art. 7, regulating Lei n.º 99/IX/2020

figures.applies: Every support programme of the decree (production, finishing, festivals, associations). Companies held by persons who don't meet the requirements are excluded too (art. 7.2.a).
